approvedFor: Shared Modern Classic identity for the Education home, subject and learning pages
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: high-fidelity visual identity reference board for EDUCATION, a collection of interactive German learning websites.
Create ONE standalone landscape brand direction board, approximately 1536x1024, flat edge-to-edge artwork with crisp readable typography, carefully composed as a professional design studio's presentation. This is a palette, typography and graphic-language reference, not a website page mockup. It will be used as an image reference when page mockups are created later.
Show: five large palette swatches with exact supplied hex labels; large display typography specimen and a short readable body-type specimen; the supplied candidate font pairing identified clearly as a type direction; a cohesive family of educational graphic motifs with one dominant expressive example; a few small UI material specimens such as a chapter marker, a play button on an illustrative video-preview crop, and a knowledge-check selection. Leave generous breathing room and use purposeful composition rather than a dashboard of equal cards.
Use these exact German content specimens wherever useful: "EDUCATION", "Licht verstehen", "Entdecken. Verstehen. Anwenden.", "Kapitel 03", "Wissen testen", "Lernzettel". Labels: "Palette", "Typografie", "Grafiksprache". These are samples of future learning materials, not claims about a live product. No fake statistics, no testimonials, no device frames, no photographs of a board on a desk, no browser frame, no external logos, no lorem ipsum, no watermarks. Body copy and small controls must remain readable. Aim for an unmistakable, internally coherent identity rather than merely changing accent colors. 
Direction: MODERN CLASSIC / EDITORIAL LIGHT. Contemporary literary magazine meets a thoughtfully designed learning journal. Warm off-white ground, forest-green ink, terracotta emphasis and soft sage, spare art direction and refined asymmetry. Graceful contemporary serif display paired with clean humanist sans-serif body and UI; unusually beautiful typography, well-paced whitespace, quiet thin dividers, subtly rounded functional controls. Candidate type: Newsreader for display, Manrope for body and UI. Palette swatches exactly #F8F6F0, #263D35, #B75B42, #CBD4C3, #E4DBCA. Graphic language: flat editorial cut-paper geometry and delicate analytical linework showing an optical lens, light paths and overlapping translucent planes, elegant and tactile but not handmade doodles. Use one generous graphic arrangement, small supporting motifs and a crisp type specimen. This direction should feel calm, cultured, approachable and current, visibly distinct from a traditional academic atlas and from aggressive digital modernism. Make the title "Modern classic" visible.
